feed.headline: Protesters blame 'vulture funds' for Spain's housing crisis
feed.ai: Hundreds have pitched their tents in central Madrid, while the Spanish prime minister has called a snap election.

feed.headline: Italy approves elections overhaul as opposition accuse Meloni of 'scam'
feed.ai: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni says the move will deliver more stable government, but opposition parties say her aim is to stay in power.

feed.headline: Spain PM pins hopes on housing crisis to help win snap election
feed.ai: Calling of a snap election was not a knee-jerk reaction from Pedro Sánchez but a carefully thought-out manoeuvre, Guy Hedgecoe reports from Madrid.

feed.headline: China and Europe Agree to Deal to Limit Chinese Exports of Hybrid Cars
feed.ai: The European Union said that the deal could roughly halve Chinese shipments over four years. But it also could lead to an even stronger Chinese auto industry.

feed.headline: Russian strikes and approaching winter force some in Kyiv to pack bags and flee
feed.ai: A renewed Russian campaign of strikes on power and energy infrastructure has made some contemplate leaving Ukraine's capital.

feed.headline: UK and Germany will face threats together, says Burnham in Berlin
feed.ai: Ahead of a UK-EU summit next month, Burnham said he was committed to "see if we can bring the UK closer to Europe".

feed.headline: 'Come all the way' back to EU, French finance minister tells UK
feed.ai: Roland Lescure tells the BBC that being in the bloc enables members to better address the challenges facing the world.

feed.headline: As Putin Wages Shadow War, Europe Looks for a Way to Hit Back
feed.ai: Moscow has used tactics of fear and ambiguity to try to divide NATO and limit support for Ukraine. But how should Europe retaliate? And how hard?

feed.headline: Labour Holds Off Green Party in Election for Starmer’s Former London Seat
feed.ai: Sagal Abdi-Wali won a special election in central London that was seen as an early test for Prime Minister Andy Burnham.

feed.headline: A Rural Village Voted to Leave the U.K., Stirring Britain’s Migration Debate
feed.ai: A plan to house 1,250 asylum seekers on the outskirts of Piddington prompted a symbolic independence vote, highlighting a growing dilemma for the government.

feed.headline: Margaret Papandreou, American-Born First Lady of Greece, Dies at 102
feed.ai: The wife of Prime Minister Andreas Papandreou, she led reforms in the 1980s that helped legalize abortion and end other legal and social restrictions on women.

feed.headline: Putin offers help to end Iran war while Russia continues its own in Ukraine
feed.ai: The Russian president met Pezeshkian in Turkmenistan and pledged to do “everything in our power” to end the ongoing war between the US and Iran, despite Russia not being among the official mediators.
